comparison.objective: Hold a piano lid while placing its prop; the candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Support a heavy articulated lid while positioning a separate load-bearing prop, not coaxial countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Prop must safely support the released lid; the indexed body lacks a complete numeric rubric.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual stabilization is generic; the load-support and jam-nut mechanisms are different.
